mapper.sql: ASSET_ID, ASSET_CODE, ASSET_NAME, CATEGORY_ID, ORIGINAL_VALUE, RESIDUAL_VALUE, ACCUMULATED_DEPRECIATION, NET_VALUE, DEPRECIATION_METHOD, USEFUL_LIFE, DEPT_ID, RESPONSIBLE_PERSON, PURCHASE_DATE, START_DEPRECIATION_DATE, STATUS, SPECIFICATION, MANUFACTURER, SUPPLIER, LOCATION, REMARK, TENANT_ID, CREATE_BY, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_BY, UPDATE_TIME, IS_DELETED
mapper.select: SELECT a.ASSET_ID, a.ASSET_CODE, a.ASSET_NAME, a.CATEGORY_ID, a.ORIGINAL_VALUE, a.RESIDUAL_VALUE, a.ACCUMULATED_DEPRECIATION, a.NET_VALUE, a.DEPRECIATION_METHOD, a.USEFUL_LIFE, a.DEPT_ID, a.RESPONSIBLE_PERSON, a.PURCHASE_DATE, a.START_DEPRECIATION_DATE, a.STATUS, a.SPECIFICATION, a.MANUFACTURER, a.SUPPLIER, a.LOCATION, a.REMARK, a.TENANT_ID, a.CREATE_BY, a.CREATE_TIME, a.UPDATE_BY, a.UPDATE_TIME, a.IS_DELETED, c.CATEGORY_NAME AS categoryName, d.ORGNAME AS deptName FROM TBL_FIXED_ASSET_CARD a LEFT JOIN TBL_FIXED_ASSET_CATEGORY c ON a.CATEGORY_ID = c.CATEGORY_ID AND c.IS_DELETED = 0 LEFT JOIN TBL_ORGANIZATION d ON a.DEPT_ID = d.ORGID AND (d.STATUS IS NULL OR d.STATUS = 0) WHERE a.ASSET_ID = #{assetId} AND a.IS_DELETED = 0

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, NVL(SUM(ORIGINAL_VALUE), 0) AS totalOriginalValue, NVL(SUM(ACCUMULATED_DEPRECIATION), 0) AS totalAccumulatedDepreciation, NVL(SUM(NET_VALUE), 0) AS totalNetValue FROM TBL_FIXED_ASSET_CARD WHERE IS_DELETED = 0
AND TENANT_ID = #{tenantId}
